title: Gemfibrozil's cytotoxicity and DNA protection: PPAR-alpha agonism overrides genotoxicity in lymphocytes.
authors: Husunet, Mehmet Tahir; Istifli, Erman Salih; Boz, Busra; Mese, Rumeysa; Abdelsalam, Amine Hafis; Ila, Hasan Basri
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接评估吉非罗齐与DNA及PPAR-alpha的结合，但核心是药物毒理学而非TF-DNA互作机制，方法简单且非AI/物理模拟。
abstract: Fibrates, carboxylic acid derivatives used in hypercholesterolemia treatment, are classified as non-genotoxic carcinogens. However, induce oxidative stress and DNA damage. This study investigates the genotoxic effects of gemfibrozil (GMF), a hypolipidemic agent, on human peripheral blood lymphocytes through cytokinesis-block micronucleus (CBMN) and alkaline comet assays. Plasmid DNA (pBR322) assessed GMF's DNA protective effects, while total oxidant (TOS) and antioxidant (TAS) status quantified oxidative stress modulation. Molecular docking simulations evaluated non-covalent interactions of GMF against DNA and peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor alpha (PPAR-alpha). At 25-250 microg/mL, GMF did not induce micronuclei (24-48 h) but triggered significant DNA fragmentation at 250 microg/mL (p < 0.01). GMF significantly reduced cytokinesis-block proliferation index (CBPI) across all concentrations and durations (p < 0.001), except 25 microg/mL (48 h). In a cell-free system, GMF exhibited a complex, bimodal protective effect against H(2)O(2)-induced plasmid damage, offering protection at 25 and 175 microg/mL but not at 100 microg/mL. However, TOS/TAS levels remained unaltered. Molecular docking demonstrated weak DNA binding (DeltaG =  -5.93 kcal/mol) compared to mitomycin C (DeltaG =  -7.25 kcal/mol), but strong PPAR-alpha affinity (DeltaG =  -7.40 kcal/mol). These findings suggest GMF exerts cytotoxicity via disrupted cell division kinetics rather than direct DNA damage or oxidative stress. Despite a low genotoxic risk of GMF in vitro. In vivo studies are critical to confirm safety.
abstract_zh: 贝特类（fibrates）药物，作为用于高胆固醇血症治疗的羧酸衍生物，被归类为非遗传毒性致癌物。然而，它们可诱导氧化应激和DNA损伤。本研究通过胞质分裂阻断微核（cytokinesis-block micronucleus, CBMN）和碱性彗星实验，探讨了降脂药吉非罗齐（gemfibrozil, GMF）对人外周血淋巴细胞的遗传毒性效应。质粒DNA（pBR322）用于评估GMF的DNA保护作用，而总氧化状态（TOS）和总抗氧化状态（TAS）用于量化氧化应激调节。分子对接模拟评估了GMF与DNA及过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体α（peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor alpha, PPAR-alpha）的非共价相互作用。在25-250微克/毫升浓度下，GMF未诱导微核形成（24-48小时），但在250微克/毫升浓度下显著引发DNA断裂（p < 0.01）。GMF在所有浓度和时间点均显著降低胞质分裂阻断增殖指数（cytokinesis-block proliferation index, CBPI）（p < 0.001），但25微克/毫升（48小时）除外。在无细胞系统中，GMF对H(2)O(2)诱导的质粒损伤表现出复杂的双相保护效应，在25和175微克/毫升浓度下提供保护，但在100微克/毫升浓度下无保护作用。然而，TOS/TAS水平未发生改变。分子对接显示，与丝裂霉素C（DeltaG = -7.25 kcal/mol）相比，GMF与DNA的结合较弱（DeltaG = -5.93 kcal/mol），但与PPAR-alpha的亲和力较强（DeltaG = -7.40 kcal/mol）。这些发现表明，GMF通过干扰细胞分裂动力学而非直接DNA损伤或氧化应激发挥细胞毒性作用。尽管GMF在体外遗传毒性风险较低，但仍需体内研究以确认其安全性。
